notes:
Summary: Mid-market B2B SaaS (product discovery + in-app search) evaluating Redwood Hosted API for embeddings and semantic search with a likely move to Dedicated if throughput/residency SLA checks out.

Context: Auric Loop runs a product discovery layer used by ~500 customers; search is a core monetized feature. Current infra: PostgreSQL + a Redis cache + experimental Faiss cluster for heavy accounts. Want to replace/embed vector infra with managed embeddings + close coupling to a managed vector DB or keep Faiss but use Redwood for embedding compute.

POC plan (agreed): 2-week hosted POC -> 2-week dedicated trial if Hosted meets quality. POC scope:
- Ingest ~200k docs (initial slice) and run nightly batch embeddings (target 200k/day)
- Real-time query latency target: median <50ms tail 95% <120ms for vector search (combined retrieval+re-rank)
- Throughput target for embedding API: support burst 300 req/s, sustained 100 req/s during indexing windows
- Evaluate integration with existing Faiss cluster and test with Pinecone managed also (cost/latency comparison)

Tech notes from SE call: prefer open-source/lightweight embed models initially (Llama2-derived or small Mistral variants) but open to Redwood's curated embeddings if token/unit economics favorable. Concern about egress costs when moving vectors between regions and hosting providers — legal flagged EU residency for some enterprise customers.

Security/compliance: SOC2 required; SSO/SAML and audit logging mandatory. Want KMS support and ability to set retention periods per customer.

Commercial: price sensitive — unit cost per 1k embeddings and per-query costs matter. Team asked for committed throughput pricing sheet to compare hosted vs dedicated; leaning Dedicated for predictability if committed pricing is within 20-30% of hosted at scale.

Quotes / call clips: "If we can't get predictable tokens/embedding pricing we can't forecast margin for the search product." — Head of Product (recorded).

Open questions / risks:
- Can Redwood support nightly batch jobs at scale without token spike penalties?
- How easy is routing to Dedicated from Hosted (can we start on Hosted and seamlessly cutover)?
- Will vector DB connectors (Pinecone, Milvus, Faiss) be first-class and supported in the Console?

Next actions (short):
- AE/Jordan to share sizing worksheet and committed throughput pricing by 2026-03-12 (pending).
- SE/Priya to run 100k/day embedding trial on Hosted with Auric Loop data subset week of 2026-03-15.
- Legal to review residency terms; kickoff meeting scheduled 2026-03-11 (SEC-1180).

Staging notes: Decision committee includes Head of Product, CTO, and Infrastructure Lead. Procurement timeline ~6–8 weeks post-POC.

CRM shorthand: POC scoped, infra concerns (egress/residency), pricing is main gating item — medium-close probability if numbers align.
